design: Two time controls at the same 3x cap as the roles sweep: vanilla (no machinery) vs directive-only (fixed neutral deliberation). Decides whether the 5/5 roles sweep is a time effect.
verdict: Time alone is insufficient (ctl fails at 900s and 2700s). The directive instruction is doing the work: it flips query-optimize from 0 to 1 with zero branch deliberation behind it. The branch ensemble adds nothing measurable on top (rp arms 5/5 where noop also passes).
caveats: n=1 per cell throughout this entire program; all contrasts descriptive.
GLM 5.3 controller only; other controllers may differ.
The directive effect mechanism (convergence discipline vs file hygiene vs verification habit) is not isolated further.
